features.title: Sized for two, made for sharing
features.text: Balanced seating lets two people relax side by side, perfect for conversations, quiet evenings, or cozy TV marathons.

features.title: Pocket-spring bounce for comfort
features.text: Built with springs in foam, the seat feels buoyant and supportive, so long hours never feel heavy or tiring.

features.title: Tailored stitching for elegance
features.text: Refined lines and neat stitchwork give the sofa a polished look that enhances your living space instantly.

features.title: Soft fabric you love to touch
features.text: Smooth upholstery keeps the seat inviting against your skin, so it always feels pleasant in every season.

features.title: Pink shade that energizes décor
features.text: The bold fabric tone brightens your room, adding personality and a vibrant edge to your interiors.
